extraction_notes: Digitised plotted catalytic-performance points from SI Figures S1, S4a, and S6 only. SI Figure S4b is catalyst surface area, and SI Figures S2, S3, S5, S7, and S8 are characterization/operando spectra, not catalytic-performance plots. SI tables were not re-extracted. For SI Figure S6, black-circle left-axis STY and blue-diamond right-axis In-specific reaction rate are reported as separate plotted performance points because the schema has one methanol STY/rate field per record.
